_about: Components to add to pre-2020 incidents that name no component on the uptime
page, or not all the components they affected, assigned by reading each
incident's updates. scrape-data.py adds the listed components to each incident,
so list only components it doesn't already name, and skips the ones under
Incidents about notifications only are left out, matching how GitHub has filed
_rules: 'Web' or 'GitHub.com' problems count as Issues (the import mapped the old 'web' tag to 'Issues, PRs, Dashboard, Projects').
Pull request problems before 2020-09 count as Issues; the Pull Requests component did not exist yet.
Webhook problems count as Webhooks even before that component was created on 2019-11-13.
Raw, release and archive downloads, forks and Git LFS count as Git Operations; search and attachments count as Issues.
Incidents naming no service ("elevated error rates", "a number of services") count as web and API: Issues and API Requests.
